metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Greenwood Village, CO
metaDescription: Hold severed minerals connected to Greenwood Village, Arapahoe County? We confirm title against county records and make a direct offer.
heroLead: Greenwood Village is affluent, fully developed Denver-metro suburb, and mineral interests connected to it almost always predate the office towers and neighborhoods that sit there now.
intro: These interests typically trace back to farmland sold for development decades ago, where the original owner kept the mineral estate as a hedge or simply as part of the standard practice at the time. Current owners are usually descendants who inherited a fractional share with little context.

The real question is whether that severed interest sits inside a producing DJ Basin unit or has never been leased at all. We answer that by checking Arapahoe County records against your legal description before discussing value.

sections.heading: Confirming the severance
paragraphs: We start by verifying that a mineral severance actually occurred and locating the exact legal description it applies to, since Greenwood Village addresses do not always match the historical farmland parcel boundaries beneath them.

sections.heading: Producing or unleased
paragraphs: If the tract is in an active unit, we price off trailing production and decline curve. If it has never been leased, we price against comparable unleased Arapahoe County sales, which run more conservative given the developed, unlikely-to-drill surface.

sections.heading: A quiet, low-effort process
paragraphs: For owners who are busy or simply do not want a drawn-out sale process, we handle the county-level research and paperwork so the whole transaction requires minimal ongoing effort on your end.

sections.heading: What if the family disagrees about selling
paragraphs: It is common for one heir to want to sell while others are undecided or unreachable. We can buy an individual co-owner's undivided share on its own, without requiring the rest of the family to agree or participate in the same transaction.

faqs.question: How do I know if my family's old farmland here still has severed minerals?
faqs.answer: Send us any deed or inheritance paperwork and we will confirm the severance and legal description through Arapahoe County records.

faqs.question: Would a well ever be drilled in Greenwood Village itself?
faqs.answer: Very unlikely given the developed surface, though the mineral estate underneath could still be part of a unit reached from elsewhere.

faqs.question: Is this process time-consuming for me?
faqs.answer: No, we handle the research and paperwork. Most owners just need to review and sign once we have a confirmed offer.

faqs.question: My siblings are not interested in selling their share. Can I still sell mine?
faqs.answer: Yes, we buy individual undivided shares regularly without requiring other co-owners to participate.
